metadata.title: SpaceX Earnings Are Lifting the Stock—and the Entire Market<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
SpaceX Stock to $500? Strong Earnings Are Lifting Tech Stocks.
SpaceX stock soared Wednesday as Wall Street gushed over another quarterly earnings beat. (One analyst price target rose 108% to $500.) The results are rippling across the market, helping other stocks, too.
